newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:
Net sales of 96,900 MT were four and one-quarter times the 4-week average. Increases were posted for Mexico (53,000 MT) and Israel (45,000 MT). Reductions of 1,100 MT were reported for Japan.
Sales of 16,300 MT for delivery in the 1997/98 marketing year were all for Japan.
Exports of 9,000 MT were down 44 percent from the prior week and 79 percent from the 4-week average. Japan (8,000 MT) and Mexico (1,000 MT) were the destinations.
